meal.title: HTML and XML share the same tag structure
meal.objective: Describe how HTML structure is similar to XML

voice.script:
Ever wondered why HTML feels like XML? If you're at all familiar with XML then it's very similar to that. Both use tags enclosed in angle brackets, a hierarchical tree, and closing tags to define structure. Think of a document as a family tree: each element can contain children, just like XML elements. That similarity means the parsing tools you learn for XML work for HTML too. So when you see
or

, treat them as XML nodes.
